evidence.country_semantics: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 buyer organization countries; not necessarily place of performance or eligibility
evidence.deadline_semantics: Earliest calendar date among reported tender-receipt lot dates; no implied exact UTC instant, open/closed status, or universal lot deadline
evidence.title_language: English display title where supplied by TED; procurement title content can remain in the source language
evidence.correction_semantics: Only change-notice-version-identifier creates a correction edge. Procedure and contract-modification predecessors are retained separately and never converted into correction edges.
evidence.privacy: Only the enumerated identifier, organization, classification and date fields are requested and retained. No email, phone, street address or person/contact fields. Original XML is hashed and discarded after extracting selected identifiers/dates.
